# Advanced Alchemy

> A carefully crafted, thoroughly tested, optimized companion library for SQLAlchemy.

Full documentation corpus: https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/llms-full.txt

## Overview & Getting Started

- [Advanced Alchemy](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/): Write clean SQLAlchemy applications without repeating database boilerplate.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/getting-started.html): When you build an app with SQLAlchemy from scratch, you end up writing the same plumbing over and over: ID and timestamp columns on every table, select() and pagination queries in every endpoint, and session cleanup c...
- [Usage Guide](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/index.html): Imagine you are building a blog with Posts, Authors, and Tags. A reader opens your home page, asks for page 2 of published posts, and creates a comment.

## Usage Guides

- [Data Modeling](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/index.html): Every database table needs a few essentials: a primary key, clear column types, and usually created_at and updated_at timestamps so you know when rows changed.
- [Modeling Basics](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/basics.html): When you create a new table—like BlogPost or Author—you almost always want an id column and created_at / updated_at timestamps. Instead of copying those columns onto every model, inherit from one of Advanced Alchemy’s...
- [Inheritance Patterns](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/inheritance.html): Sometimes several models share most of their fields—for example, Managers and Engineers are both Employees, or Articles and Videos are both Posts.
- [SQLModel Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/sqlmodel.html): If your team already writes tables with SQLModel, you can plug those models straight into Advanced Alchemy repositories without rewriting your model classes.
- [Portable Column Types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/types.html): Different SQL databases use different column types for UUIDs, UTC timestamps, JSON, and AI vector embeddings—especially when you test against SQLite locally and deploy to PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle in production.
- [Security and File Storage Types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/modeling/security_and_storage_types.html): Most apps eventually need to store sensitive values—API keys, user passwords, two-factor login codes—or attach uploaded files like avatars and PDF reports to a database row.
- [Repositories](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/index.html): Without a repository, every web route ends up repeating the same SQLAlchemy query code: building a select(), adding where() clauses, counting total rows for pagination, and handling NoResultFound errors.
- [Repository Basics](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/basics.html): Think of a Repository as a dedicated helper for one database table. Instead of writing raw SQLAlchemy select() and session.add() calls throughout your app, you point a repository at your Post model once and call clear...
- [Filtering and Pagination](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/filtering.html): Suppose a reader visits your blog and searches for "python", filters to published articles from the past week, and views 20 posts per page.
- [Advanced Repository](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/repositories/advanced.html): Most tables have a single id column and simple single-row updates. When you run into trickier real-world cases—join tables with two-part keys, concurrent checkout updates, or clearing old drafts in one query—repositor...
- [Services](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/services.html): A Repository speaks in database tables (BlogPost rows), while a Service speaks in your API’s input and output shapes (BlogPostCreate, BlogPostResponse) and gives you one clean home for business rules—such as creating...
- [Read/Write Routing](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/routing.html): As your app grows, most database traffic is reading data—loading feeds, search pages, and dashboards—while only a fraction is saving changes.
- [Caching](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/caching.html): Imagine 500 visitors opening the same popular author page at the exact same second. Without a cache, your database runs the exact same SELECT query 500 times.
- [CLI & Migrations](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/cli.html): Whenever you add a column or create a new table in Python, your SQL database needs a migration script to apply that change safely.
- [CLI Command Workflows](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/cli_commands.html): Once your config is connected, day-to-day schema changes follow the same commands whether you run alchemy ..., litestar database ..., or flask database ....
- [Database Seeding](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/database_seeding.html): When setting up a new environment or staging server, you often want starter rows—such as default roles, categories, or sample products—loaded from version-controlled .json or .csv files.
- [Framework Integrations](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/index.html): Instead of manually opening, committing, and closing SQLAlchemy sessions inside every web route, Advanced Alchemy plugs directly into your web framework.
- [Litestar Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar.html): Advanced Alchemy is built by the Litestar team and plugs into Litestar with a single SQLAlchemyPlugin. One plugin setup handles database connections, per-request sessions, JSON serialization, error responses, and lite...
- [Litestar Services, Filters and DTOs](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_dtos.html): When building CRUD routes in Litestar, you rarely want to wire up db_session manually or hand-write query parameters for pagination, search, and sorting on every controller.
- [Litestar Database and Server Sessions](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_sessions.html): This guide covers two kinds of “sessions” in Litestar:
- [Litestar File and Object Storage](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/litestar_storage.html): Uploading user avatars, invoices, or attachments usually creates headaches: if a database commit fails after uploading to S3, you get orphaned files; if a row is deleted, someone forgets to delete the file in storage.
- [FastAPI Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi.html): Advanced Alchemy plugs into FastAPI through the AdvancedAlchemy extension, managing database startup/shutdown automatically and giving your routes clean Depends(...) helpers for sessions, services, and OpenAPI-documen...
- [FastAPI Services and Filter Depends](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi_dependencies.html): FastAPI routes use Depends(...) to inject database sessions, services, and query parameters. Advanced Alchemy’s AdvancedAlchemy extension builds these Depends callables for you and adds pagination, search, sorting, an...
- [FastAPI File Storage and Multi-Binds](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/fastapi_storage.html): This guide shows how to attach uploaded files to SQLAlchemy models in FastAPI and how to connect a single FastAPI app to more than one database.
- [Starlette Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/starlette.html): For lightweight ASGI services built on Starlette, AdvancedAlchemy manages engine startup/shutdown and attaches a request-scoped database session to request.state automatically.
- [Flask Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/flask.html): Advanced Alchemy plugs into both classic synchronous Flask apps and async def Flask routes—giving every request a managed SQLAlchemy session, adding a jsonify() helper onto your services, and registering flask databas...
- [Sanic Integration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/usage/frameworks/sanic.html): Advanced Alchemy integrates with Sanic through sanic-ext, managing engines on app.ctx, creating lazy per-request sessions on request.ctx, and injecting AsyncSession straight into route handlers.

## API Reference

- [API Reference](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/index.html): Complete class, function, and module reference for Advanced Alchemy. Browse any module in the left sidebar or select a section below.
- [Declarative Base](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/base.html): Documentation for Declarative Base.
- [Mixins](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/index.html): Mixins that provide common columns and behavior for SQLAlchemy models.
- [Unique Key](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/unique.html): Documentation for Unique Key.
- [NanoID](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/nanoid.html): Documentation for NanoID.
- [UUID](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/uuid.html): Documentation for UUID.
- [Sentinel](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/sentinel.html): Documentation for Sentinel.
- [BigInt](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/bigint.html): Documentation for BigInt.
- [Audit](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/audit.html): Documentation for Audit.
- [Slug](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/mixins/slug.html): Documentation for Slug.
- [Configuration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/index.html): API Reference for the Config module
- [Asyncio](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/asyncio.html): Documentation for Asyncio.
- [Common](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/common.html): Documentation for Common.
- [Engine](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/engine.html): Documentation for Engine.
- [Routing](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/routing.html): Configuration classes for read/write replica routing.
- [Sync](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/sync.html): Sync SQLAlchemy configuration module.
- [Types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/config/types.html): Type aliases and constants used in the package config.
- [Repositories](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/repository.html): Documentation for Repositories.
- [Memory Repositories](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/repository_memory.html): Documentation for Memory Repositories.
- [Services](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/service.html): Documentation for Services.
- [Filters](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/filters.html): Documentation for Filters.
- [Bulk Operations](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/operations.html): Documentation for Bulk Operations.
- [Custom Types](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/types.html): Documentation for Custom Types.
- [Replica Routing](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/routing.html): Read/write replica session routing for SQLAlchemy engines and sessions. See RoutingConfig, ReplicaConfig, and RoutingStrategy for configuration.
- [Caching](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/cache.html): Dogpile L2 caching integration for SQLAlchemy repositories with commit-aware invalidation and per-process singleflight protection.
- [Extensions](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/index.html): API Reference for the advanced_alchemy.extensions framework integration packages.
- [Litestar](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/index.html): Litestar framework integration providing plugins, session lifecycle handlers, dependency injection providers, DTOs, server-side session backends, and CLI commands.
- [Plugins & Configuration](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/plugins.html): Documentation for Plugins & Configuration.
- [Data Transfer Objects](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/dto.html): Documentation for Data Transfer Objects.
- [Session Backends](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/session.html): This module provides SQLAlchemy-based session backends for Litestar’s server-side session middleware.
- [SQLAlchemy Store](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/store.html): This module provides a SQLAlchemy-backed implementation of Litestar’s Store protocol. Register a SQLAlchemyStore under the "sessions" store name to back Litestar’s server-side session middleware with your SQLAlchemy d...
- [CLI Commands](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/litestar/cli.html): Litestar CLI database group and plugin discovery utilities.
- [FastAPI](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/fastapi/index.html): API Reference for the FastAPI extensions module.
- [Starlette](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/starlette/index.html): API Reference for the Starlette extensions module.
- [Flask](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/flask/index.html): API Reference for the Flask extensions module.
- [Sanic](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/extensions/sanic/index.html): API Reference for the Sanic extensions module.
- [Alembic](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/index.html): API Reference for the Alembic module
- [Commands](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/commands.html): Documentation for Commands.
- [Utilities](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/alembic/utils.html): Documentation for Utilities.
- [Command-Line Interface](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/cli.html): Command-line interface and migration commands for Advanced Alchemy.
- [Exceptions](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/exceptions.html): Exception hierarchy and SQLAlchemy error translation utilities converting low-level driver errors such as sqlalchemy.exc.IntegrityError and sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError into typed domain exceptions.
- [Utilities](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/reference/utils.html): Documentation for Utilities.

## Project & Changelog

- [1.x Changelog](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/changelog.html): SQLAlchemyAsyncRepositoryService[Model] and SQLAlchemySyncRepositoryService[Model] subclasses no longer need an inline repository_type; the model and a default repository are inferred from the generic parameters, and...
- [Contribution Guide](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/contribution-guide.html): 1. Run make install-uv to install uv if not already installed 1. Run make install to install all dependencies and pre-commit hooks
- [Advanced Alchemy Releases](https://docs.advanced-alchemy.litestar.dev/latest/releases.html): This library follows the Semantic Versioning standard, using the <major>.<minor>.<patch> schema:
